backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, stats, availability, daily logs, chat messages, and access control with various query helpers. Includes availability checks, user-related filtering, and mixins for storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented PWA and UX features to source files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of major frontend files including components, hooks, pages, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styling for the app.
frontend/index.html: App HTML entrypoint setting up PWA metadata, splash screens, icons, and loading the main React script.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, colors, display mode, and start URL for Somers Scheduler.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with simple styling and a retry button for when the app has no network connectivity.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker that precaches core assets, cleans old caches, and handles fetch requests with network-first and offline fallback strategies.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up app routing, authentication gating, and initial user/leaderboard loading with a main layout wrapper.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an admin-only access denied message with a link back to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Renders the login UI with branding and triggers Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple logo component that displays the configured branding image.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Chat UI that loads recent messages, lets users send messages, and manages scrolling and message visibility.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main page layout including top bar, navigation, offline banner, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Navigation bar showing primary routes and conditionally the admin link based on user role.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Top bar with app branding, theme toggle, PWA install button, and user dropdown with logout.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: User profile card allowing name editing and profile picture upload with progress tracking via backend mutation.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Displays the caller's all‑time leaderboard rank with loading skeleton support.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Fetches and displays the caller's match history with loading, empty, and error states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting new users to enter and save their name as part of initial profile setup.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallInstr: Dialog showing platform‑specific steps for installing the PWA to the home screen.
frontend/src/components/pwa/OfflineBanne: Shows a fixed banner when the app detects the user is offline.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps children with a page background using a fixed low‑opacity image.
Renders a user avatar with initials fallback and their display name in configurable sizes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Hooks to fetch the caller's user role and admin status from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, managing identity state and login flow.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Provides a hook that detects PWA install availability and triggers the beforeinstallprompt flow, including iOS handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, availability data, and statistics via an actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Handles light/dark theme state with localStorage persistence and DOM class updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Contains hooks for resolving principals to display names or avatars using backend profiles with caching via React Query.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base/styles plus custom CSS variables, dark mode theming, safe-area support, and layout behaviors.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports static branding info like app name and logo URLs.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Provides date utilities for converting to/from day IDs, generating month grids, and formatting dates and times.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Renders the React app root wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Form page for adding or editing a user's availability with time selection, notes, and submission handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard for viewing, sorting, and deleting users and availabilities with role checks.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Monthly calendar view showing days with availability and linking to day details, plus embedded chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Standalone page rendering the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Displays all availabilities for a selected day with options for the user to edit or delete their own entry.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Leaderboard with ranking, win/loss recording, available days selection, and rank improvement notifications.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing personal info, leaderboard rank, and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Utility for converting files to Uint8Array and generating initials from names.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Provides utilities for generating time options and parsing/formatting 12-hour time strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, container settings, and plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Defines the project's PWA-related state, including features, requirements, planned enhancements, and needed splash screen assets.
